name: umbra
description: Local-first AI studio (GUI and TUI) for running and inspecting language models on your own hardware. Being built against an NVIDIA DGX Spark. Early development — not usable yet.

name: gate
description: Pre-commit hook that scans staged changes for credentials and can attempt bounded rewrites for supported source forms. Pattern-based, so expect false positives and misses.

name: vexes
description: Experimental local CLI for OSV advisory matches plus heuristic npm/PyPI supply-chain evidence. Findings are review signals, not safety verdicts, and incomplete checks fail visibly.

name: mcp-librarian
description: Experimental MCP server for a local Markdown skill library. BM25 search is local; web research and pack operations are explicit network paths. Ed25519 status is recorded during indexing, but load responses do not enforce it.
